findingClass: the BSE payload lists more lead managers than we stored (the co-BRLM parser drops entries after the first "#"-separated one)
failThreshold: array_length(lead_managers) < ipos.bse_payload_lead_manager_count for any IPO. Storing MORE is not flagged: other sources legitimately add managers BSE omits
unverifiableWhen: no IPO has a recorded bse_payload_lead_manager_count yet
